authority: Official platform docs for volatile limits; approved_video_template.json remains the visual/rendering master.
rule: Never promote an ad-only recommendation, one account tier limit, or a dated metric definition into a universal organic-video rule.

common_delivery_contract.canonical_shortform: 9:16; 720x1280; 30fps; H.264/AAC/yuv420p/faststart when accepted by the target platform and existing renderer

youtube.scope: ORGANIC_AND_CREATOR_ANALYTICS; paid traffic must be segmented
youtube.profile: vertical shortform is eligible for Shorts; current project baseline remains 30-60s unless task intent requires otherwise
volatile_facts: YouTube Help currently allows Shorts up to 3 minutes; verify upload UI before export when duration matters.

Since 2026-08-24, a view counts when a video starts playing across formats; YPP eligibility/earnings use engaged/qualified metrics as applicable. Never compare pre/post-change raw views as if definition were unchanged.
youtube.review_loop: After enough processing time, inspect video-level audience retention dips, spikes, and opening expectation match; YouTube says retention processing typically takes 1-2 days. Use results as diagnosis, not a guaranteed algorithm recipe.

instagram_reels.scope: ORGANIC_CREATOR_GUIDANCE; account features and availability can vary
instagram_reels.profile: Do not hard-code a universal duration, resolution, ranking factor, or safe-area number here. Check current in-app upload preview and the Professional Dashboard Best Practices for the account.
instagram_reels.experiments: If Trial Reels is visible for the account, it may be used to test a topic/format with non-followers first; availability and auto-share behavior must be rechecked in product UI. Never promise a reach outcome.

x_organic.profile: Use a platform-specific preview and check account's current upload limits. X Help currently documents up to 140 seconds/512MB for non-Premium web uploads and higher tier-specific Premium limits; treat these as volatile, not a production master setting.
x_organic.accessibility: X supports adding an SRT caption file on posts. Keep a timed SRT sidecar when available; verify the uploaded language/caption state in the compose UI. Burned-in captions remain part of this project's visual baseline.

x_ads.scope: PAID_AD_CREATIVE_ONLY; never apply as organic performance law
x_ads.profile: X Business vertical-video guidance is an ad-format reference only. Use it only when a task explicitly requests ad creative and after checking current campaign placement specs.

principles: Keep source script, claim/source map, edit manifest, and deterministic validators versioned; keep large transient media and third-party binary assets out of git unless required by explicit repo policy.
CI artifacts are traceable outputs, not canonical source; caches are disposable accelerators, never the only copy of a deliverable.
Record repository commit, policy/template identities, input hashes, tool versions, and output SHA-256 in a sidecar manifest.
For future publishing workflows, use least-privilege workflow permissions and pin third-party Actions to full commit SHAs; current PR boundaries remain in force.

For any locally run Hub model used in a video workflow, record repository ID, immutable commit revision, selected file hashes, runtime version, model-card/license URL, and intended use in the run manifest.
Pin revision to a commit SHA for repeatability; a cache is revision-aware storage, not evidence that model inputs or licenses were checked.
Inspect model-card license and intended-use metadata before use. A model-card declaration does not itself grant rights to input media or every generated output.
Use local/free paths only under the existing free-execution guard; do not turn Hub/Spaces/Jobs into an unapproved paid fallback.

maintenance.refresh_before_use_when: A platform limit, monetization condition, feature availability, upload format, or metric definition matters; or after 90 days.
maintenance.on_conflict: Keep approved presentation baseline and proven pipeline behavior. Replace only stale/conflicting platform facts at this registry, leave historical records marked historical, and remove duplicated active prose.
